How the game works

Introduction

Press PLAY and symbols fall into place on a 5×4 game board. A standard win is formed by 3 or more identical paying symbols connected horizontally or vertically. Diagonal symbols do not connect.

Winning symbols are removed and new symbols fall from above. Cascades continue until no new winning group remains. Each connected cluster is paid once according to the total number of symbols in that cluster.

Start the game

Select a play amount, then press PLAY. The selected amount is deducted from the balance when the round starts.

$0.10$0.20$0.50$1.00$2.50$10.00$20.00$30.00$50.00

End of the game

After all cascades and any triggered feature are complete, the total winnings for the round are added to the balance. Press PLAY again to start another round.

Wins above 5× the selected play amount trigger the Big Win presentation.

Prize Chart

The table above displays the prize multiple for each standard symbol. Multiply the selected play amount by the listed multiple to calculate the cluster prize.

Groups from 3 through 11 use their exact row. Any group of 12 or more symbols uses the 12+ value.

Winning

Standard paying symbols are J, Q, K, A, Blue Gem, Red Gem and Treasure Chest. Special feature symbols do not use the normal prize chart.

If a normal win and a feature trigger occur in the same round, the normal cascade sequence is resolved before the feature begins.

Special features

Multiplier

If the Multiplier symbol is present during a winning round, the round multiplier starts at x1. Every winning group revealed increases it by +1. When normal cascades end, the accumulated base win is multiplied by the final multiplier.

No normal cluster payout+1 per win

Dragon Blaze

The Dragon Blaze symbol can trigger an extra free round after the current normal wins are resolved. Extra Dragon rounds can chain if the symbol appears again.

Extra roundCan retrigger

Bonus Game

Reveal 3 Bonus symbols anywhere on the game board to enter the tower-style Bonus Game. The game highlights a valid prize position and awards the value attached to that position.

The feature creates 18 bet-scaled prize positions across ranges from 10× up to 100× the selected play amount.

Blitz Bonus Game

Reveal 3 Blitz symbols to enter the Blitz bonus. The feature contains 9 selectable eggs. Reveal eggs until 3 matching prize amounts are found; that matching amount is awarded.

Four distinct prize values are generated from bet-scaled ranges between 10× and 150× the selected play amount.

General information

Game rules

  • Winning clusters connect horizontally or vertically; diagonal-only connections do not count.
  • Only the applicable prize for each connected cluster is paid.
  • Special feature symbols are evaluated by their own feature rules and are not standard prize-chart symbols.
  • System malfunction voids affected plays and pays.

The supplied game project does not declare an RTP percentage in its game-information data, so no RTP figure is displayed here.

All text on this page is provided in English and is built from the rules and payout data contained in the supplied Dragon Blaze Construct project.
